title: A little bit about me
descriptions: I’m Alfin, a software engineer based in Malang and a computer science graduate of Institut Teknologi dan Bisnis ASIA. I work across web, mobile, and APIs, with frontend product engineering as my current focus.

At PT Ada Ide Langsung Jalan, I build features across the Smartlink and Groapp ecosystems, including cashier, owner, access, and accounting products. I work with product owners and backend engineers to turn requirements into responsive interfaces, reliable API integrations, and reusable components.

Before becoming a Senior Frontend Developer in August 2026, I led frontend engineering from January 2022 to July 2026. That work included planning, mentoring, code review, and technical standards. I also publish developer tools for localization, UI testing, and form validation—practical solutions to problems I have encountered on product teams.
